Use root `AGENTS.md` as the local context router.

Load canonical DCS context only when the task needs it:

- current release/deploy/routing/gate → DCS `STATUS.md`;
- product/monetization/PDF/Telegram/cross-surface decisions → DCS `AGENTS.md` + product strategy / relevant decision record;
- small local Web fix → affected files/tests first.

Preserve Lovable history safety: no force-push or rewriting published history.

Preserve product invariants: deterministic calculation vs interpretation separation, correction/rejection supersession, `Myth metaphor != biography`, no forced Meeting resonance padding, and semantic boldness + epistemic humility.

Use one writable executor per bounded gate, make the smallest coherent change, and verify enough to prove the acceptance criteria. Use browser/runtime evidence for UI/deployment claims. Never expose secrets or PII.
